resources.string: Use 2–3 common English words. "Hey Google" and "Hey Siri" are reserved by Google Assistant and Siri, so pick your own phrase, like "hey music" or "okay jukebox".
Things you can say after the wake phrase

• "open YouTube Music"
• "play <song, artist or playlist>"
• "change song" / "next" / "skip"
• "change to <song>"
• "previous" / "go back"
• "pause" / "stop"
• "resume" / "continue"
• "volume up" / "volume down"

Turkish works too: "sonraki", "önceki", "durdur", "devam", "sesi aç", "sesi kıs", "<şarkı> çal".
